items.title: Walter Booker and Jimmy Cobb interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995
items.q: I don’t know that I consciously liked him, because I would like concentrate on all kinds of other people but I came out sounding like that.

ctx.x: Then there was Oscar Pettiford came in off of the top of that.

Which I sort of started from there in my — I don’t know that I consciously liked him, because I would like concentrate on all kinds of other people but I came out sounding like that. When I first heard myself play, I said, I don’t want to sound— I mean I didn’t mean I don’t want to — is that me I said. But anyway, I think that’s where I really came from.
Then there was Paul Chambers. Young Paul Chambers. He came like he sounded like he was the extension off of both of them guys.
